description: Parse a canonical UUID string into a UUID value. Blank or malformed input fails with an Invalid UUID error.

inputs.name: uuid_string
inputs.description: Canonical UUID text to parse. Blank or malformed text causes an Invalid UUID error.

outputs.name: uuid_object
outputs.description: Returns the parsed UUID value when the input is valid.

description: Convert a UUID value into its canonical string form. Missing UUID input fails with a UUID is required error.

inputs.name: uuid_object
inputs.description: UUID value to format. Missing input causes a UUID is required error.

outputs.name: uuid_string
outputs.description: Returns the UUID in canonical lowercase string form.

description: Generate a new random UUID in canonical string form. UUID generation does not require inputs and fails only if the runtime cannot create a UUID.

outputs.name: uuid_string
outputs.description: Returns a newly generated random UUID in canonical string form.

description: Read the version number from a UUID. Missing UUID input fails with a UUID is required error.

inputs.name: uuid_object
inputs.description: UUID value to inspect. Missing input causes a UUID is required error.

description: Read the timestamp from a time-based UUID. Missing UUID input fails with a UUID is required error, and non-time-based UUIDs fail because they have no UUID timestamp.

inputs.name: uuid_object
inputs.description: Time-based UUID to inspect. Missing input causes a UUID is required error.

outputs.name: timestamp
outputs.description: Returns the UUID timestamp. Non-time-based UUIDs fail because they do not provide one.
